- Week 3–6 (May 24–Jun 18): DocuSign + procurement approvals

- Production reserve: 24x A100-equivalent with 10% burst allowance

Thanks for the quick questions — answers inline below, plus a suggested rhythm to reduce risk: 

1) Lead times: to guarantee an Aug 1 pilot we need signed DocuSign by June 15 latest. If you sign after that date we can still accommodate but may push initial tranche to mid-August depending on existing procurement queues.

2) Billing: pilot tranche is billed pro rata for the month it is activated; production reserve invoices begin at pool activation and follow the committed monthly cadence in the MAP.

3) Security evidence: Karthik will be your evidence lead — he can accept S3/Drive links or use a secure transfer. I attached a short SOC2 drop checklist and copied the expected artifact filenames.

Suggested mitigation to preserve Aug 1 go-live: move legal negotiations and procurement parallel to security review (two tracks). If you can commit to a signature window (by Jun 15) we will earmark the tranche.

Proposed near-term next steps:
- Tue May 4: 30-min alignment call (Vanessa + Karthik + Devin + Sarah) to walk MAP milestones
- Tue May 11: Confirm security artifact list and initial evidence drop
- Tue Jun 8: Legal completes redlines

I've re-attached the MAP and added a "commit windows" tab with exact dates.

Hi all — quick technical / operations notes to help your planning: 

- Lead time realities: For Dedicated/Private deployments we plan GPU procurement in tranches. The earliest guaranteed tranche after a signed commitment is ~6 weeks for capacity allocation and network prep. That is why the Jun 15 signature target is important for an Aug 1 activation.
- Burst & headroom: We recommend a committed pool 20–30% above baseline eval throughput to avoid throttling during peak experiments (we recommended 24 GPUs given your 12k token/min baseline).
- Quantization/instance mix: If you accept mixed instance sizes (e.g., some A10x + some A100x equivalents) we can reduce initial reserve requirements and still hit cost targets — I added two alternate pool sketches in the MAP (pages: "pool_mix_A" and "pool_mix_B").
- Acceptance testing: 1-week smoke window post-activation; any performance regressions measured against the eval prompt set will go through rollback policy in the MAP.

I'll join the Tue May 4 call to walk the pool sketches and answer any infra questions.

—Karthik
Director, Solutions (Capacity)
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
